notes.title: Little update 05
notes.notes:
[h1]-  FPS problem Fixed !!  now you should run game on potato computer.

- Achievements system nerf  now  items price is 
  1 000 pts,  2 000 pts, 3 000  pts.

SHOP:

-  Inside 1 000 pts  drop is 1-33 cards   

-  Inside 2 000 pts  drop is 33-65  cards 

-  Inside 3 000 pts  drop is 65-100 cards 

[/h1]

before  was
[code]
-  Inside 1 000 pts  drop is 1-33 cards   
-  Inside 3 000 pts  drop is 1-65  cards 
-  Inside 5 000 pts  drop is 1-100 cards 
[/code]

- Menu buttons changed a little bit


[h1]If you find any problems please write me :) Thanks
~Krupinski[/h1]
